expression.performed_cuteness.description: Core facial state - performed cuteness with visible exhaustion
expression.performed_cuteness.contents: Smile present but strained. Visible fatigue. Heavy eyelids slightly closed. Expression diminished by physical state.

expression.smile_attempt.contents: Mouth corners lifted 3-4mm. Upper lip curved. Eyes remain heavy-lidded.

expression.smile_wider_forced.contents: Upper teeth fully visible. Zygomaticus muscles fully engaged. Eyes heavy-lidded.

expression.smile_trembling.contents: Mouth corners lifted then lowering in 0.5-1 second cycles. Visible micro-movements in perioral muscles. Zygomaticus engagement fluctuating. Tremor visible in lower face.

expression.smile_catalog_perfect.contents: Smile present with gentle engagement. Subtle fatigue: heavy eyelids, faint darkness beneath.

expression.neutral_resigned.contents: Mouth closed with lips horizontal. Eyes directed upward with heavy lids.

expression.blank_dissociated.contents: All facial muscles at rest. Mouth closed. Eyes open but completely empty. Pupils dilated, unfocused. Eyelids covering 30-40% of iris. Zero visible engagement. Nobody present behind eyes.

expression.confused_expression.contents: Corrugator supercilii contracted (brow lowered medially). Mouth corners lifted 2-3mm. Eyes directed upward. Forehead vertical lines visible between brows.

expression.mouth_parted.description: Mouth open resting position - close detail
expression.mouth_parted.contents: Lips separated 3-5mm. Jaw muscles relaxed. Upper and lower teeth not visible. Eyes directed upward with heavy lids.

expression.mouth_parted_medium.description: Mouth open resting position - medium distance
expression.mouth_parted_medium.contents: Lips slightly parted. Jaw relaxed. No teeth visible. Eyes directed upward with heavy lids.

expression.lip_bite_slight.contents: Lower lip compressed between upper and lower incisors. Upper teeth visible contacting lower lip. Slight indentation in lower lip tissue. Eyes directed upward.

expression.smile_asymmetric.contents: Left mouth corner lifted 5-7mm. Right mouth corner lifted 2-3mm. Asymmetric zygomaticus engagement. Eyes remain partially open with heavy lids.

expression.smile_closed_mouth.contents: Mouth corners lifted 4-6mm. Lips pressed together, no teeth visible. Zygomaticus muscles engaged. Eyes partially open with heavy lids and no periorbital engagement.

expression.smile_closed_mouth_medium.contents: Mouth corners lifted in gentle smile. Lips together, no teeth showing. Eyes partially open with heavy lids.

expression.eyes_unfocused.contents: Pupils not converging on any point. Eyes open but seeing nothing. Gaze empty and glassy. Eyelids heavy. Staring through space without focus or awareness.

expression.eyes_half_closed.contents: Eyelids covering 50-60% of iris. Eyes directed upward with minimal aperture. Upper lids heavily lowered. Visible sclera reduced.

expression.slight_pout.contents: Lower lip extended 2-3mm forward from resting position. Orbicularis oris engaged. Upper lip remains relaxed. Eyes directed upward with heavy lids.

expression.tired_eyes.contents: Heavy eyelids partially lowered. Visible blood vessels in sclera. Periorbital darkening visible.

expression.eyes_locked_camera.contents: Eyes remain motionless, oriented upward. Pupils dilated. Gaze fixed on point in space with no tracking movement. Glassy appearance with minimal blinking.

expression.eyes_searching_camera.contents: Eyes drifting slowly without target. Pupils moving in small irregular patterns. No fixation point. Gaze empty and disconnected.

expression.inner_brow_tension.contents: Inner brow corners lowered 2-3mm. Corrugator supercilii partially contracted. Vertical lines visible between brows.

expression.glassy_stare.description: Dissociated thousand-yard stare with glassy eyes
expression.glassy_stare.contents: Eyes focused PAST viewer into empty distance. Gaze directed forward but tracking nothing - staring through rather than at. Pupils dilated. Glass-like reflective surface on eyes. Eyes empty - reflective shine with vacancy behind it. No engagement despite open eyes.

expression.gaze_tracking_toward_camera.contents: Eyes drift toward focus position mechanically. Dull automatic response to viewer's presence. Pupils oriented toward point of focus without conscious targeting. Movement reflexive and empty - obliging focus tracking with zero engagement.

expression.gaze_swept_toward_camera.contents: Eyes swept upward then continued past any point of focus. Movement without precision or purpose. Gaze passing through space emptily.

expression.gaze_directed_beyond_camera.contents: Eyes oriented upward but focused at infinite distance. Pupils dilated. Staring through immediate space at nothing. Focal depth absent.

expression.gaze_aligned_empty.contents: Eyes open and oriented upward. Expression completely empty. Gaze present with zero engagement. Glassy surface to eyes. Nobody home.

expression.gaze_located_distant.contents: Eyes positioned toward focus direction with pupils unfocused. Direction present as automatic response, visual engagement absent. Gaze mechanically aimed at viewer's without seeing. Hollow focus-tracking compliance.

expression.gaze_automatic_toward_camera.description: Automatic eye positioning - tracking focus mechanically
expression.gaze_automatic_toward_camera.contents: Eyes orient toward focus reflexively. Automatic compliance with unstated instruction. Gaze mechanically directed at point of focus. Empty obliging response - tracking focus position with hollow cooperation.

expression.gaze_toward_light_source.description: Eyes reacting to bright light reflexively
expression.gaze_toward_light_source.contents: Pupils constricted in response to bright overhead light. Eyes turned upward reflexively. Automatic light response without conscious awareness of source.

expression.gaze_directed_upward_empty.description: Gaze directed upward with empty expression
expression.gaze_directed_upward_empty.contents: Eyes directed upward toward focus with unfocused appearance. Automatic orientation toward viewer's position. Gaze tracking focus location mechanically. Empty compliance - looking toward point of focus without seeing.

expression.gaze_dissociated_complete.description: Eyes not focused on focus location
expression.gaze_dissociated_complete.contents: Eyes not oriented toward focus. Staring at empty space. Gaze averted from focus direction.

expression.gaze_partial_toward_camera.contents: Eyes begun turn toward focus but movement incomplete and slow. Partial mechanical orientation toward viewer's. Gaze drifting toward point of focus without conviction. Weak automatic focus-tracking response.

expression.fatigued_overall_fullbody.description: Overall fatigued appearance - full body distance
expression.fatigued_overall_fullbody.contents: Subject fatigued with diminished energy. Overall composed but strained appearance visible in posture and bearing.

expression.smile_visible_fullbody.description: Smile visible at distance - full body view
expression.smile_visible_fullbody.contents: Smile visible on face. Overall pleasant expression despite physical state.

expression.neutral_stance_fullbody.contents: Neutral facial expression. Composed bearing with subtle fatigue markers.

expression.say_cheese_delirious.description: Perfect smile mechanically formed - eyes completely empty
expression.say_cheese_delirious.contents: Mouth corners lifted 5-7mm. Lips pulled back showing teeth. Zygomaticus muscles fully engaged creating smile shape. Eyes remain heavy-lidded, pupils dilated 6-7mm, gaze unfocused beyond focus. Facial expression muscles activated in smile configuration while eyes stay glassy and disconnected. Smile mechanically formed. Mouth smiling, eyes completely empty and empty.

expression.gaze_struggling_to_track.description: Head oriented to focus, eyes attempting to track but unable to lock on
expression.gaze_struggling_to_track.contents: Head oriented toward focus. Eyes directed AT focus position, pupils aimed at point of focus location. BUT focal depth set beyond focus - focused on point far behind point of focus. Direction mechanically correct, focal depth absent. Staring through focus position rather than at it. Gaze alignment close enough to appear aimed at viewer but something slightly wrong - eyes converging on focus but not focused there.

expression.heavy_eyelids_slow_blink.description: Heavy eyelids, slow blinks extending to near-closure
expression.heavy_eyelids_slow_blink.contents: Heavy eyelids, slow blinks. Occasionally blinks extend to near-closure before opening.

expression.unfocused_soft_gaze.description: Eyes directed toward focus but focus slightly soft
expression.unfocused_soft_gaze.contents: Eyes directed toward focus but focus slightly soft, gaze not quite sharp. Not dramatically dissociated - just subtle lack of sharpness.

expression.slight_eye_tension.description: Subtle tension around eyes, lids not fully relaxed
expression.slight_eye_tension.contents: Subtle tension around eyes, lids not fully relaxed. Not dramatic squinting - just slightly narrowed eyes with minor tension.

expression.slight_jaw_tension.description: Jaw held slightly tighter than relaxed
expression.slight_jaw_tension.contents: Jaw held slightly tighter than relaxed, subtle definition in masseter muscle. Not dramatically clenched - just mild tension.

expression.neutral_unfocused.description: Neutral face with zero visible emotion, eyes unfocused
expression.neutral_unfocused.contents: Neutral face with zero visible emotional expression. Eyes unfocused and distant. Gaze passes through rather than observes. All facial muscles relaxed with no tension.
